name: Steadfast Perception
body:
Discipline clairsentience; Level cryptic 4, gifted blade 4, marksman 4, psychic warrior 4, sighted seeker 4

MANIFESTING

Display Visual
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Power Points 7

DESCRIPTION

Your vision cannot be distracted or misled, granting you immunity to all figments and glamers (such as invisibility). Moreover, your visual-based Perception checks receive a +6 enhancement bonus for the duration of this power. This power also grants you another saving throw against someone using false sensory input on you, but you must realize that that power has been used in order to know enough to manifest steadfast perception.
